environment.mode: production, headed browser, software-operated keyboard input

metric: Milliseconds from capture-phase input listener to next requestAnimationFrame callback; excludes initial opening and is not a paint-completion or INP measurement.
protocol: One warm-up per variant and size, then five fresh page loads per variant and size. Open the ordinary list, select the input contents, press 1. Alternate baseline/patched order across trials. All measured events were trusted, each trial had exactly one input event, and before/after rendered option counts equaled the requested count. Selected value remained Item 7.
limitations: Single workstation with a connected browser controller and existing browser extensions, not an isolated performance lab or the reporter's Linux setup. Slow baseline input/open operations sometimes exceeded the controller response deadline; the completed page metrics were read afterward without resending the input. No timed sample was discarded. Absolute times include this environment and are not a universal speedup claim. This independent fixture includes disabled Item 0/10 and a selected Item 7; it is not the reporter's exact fixture.
